system_environment.windows_app_control_state: Enforced (blocks unsigned/restricted third-party DLLs like torch_python.dll)

option_1_tflite_runtime.pypi_evidence: Google does NOT publish precompiled win_amd64 wheels for tflite-runtime on PyPI (only manylinux2014, aarch64, armv7l). There is no official .tar.gz source distribution on PyPI for compilation.
option_1_tflite_runtime.risk: Requires third-party unofficial/unverified community wheels which violate project trust constraints.

option_2_tensorflow_cpu.compatibility: Native CPU builds supported on Windows 64-bit Python 3.11 via `pip install tensorflow` (installs `tensorflow-intel`).
option_2_tensorflow_cpu.risk: Massive dependency footprint and complex DLL dependencies that could trigger App Control restrictions.

option_3_mediapipe_pose.compatibility: Official Google precompiled wheels available on PyPI for Windows 64-bit Python 3.11 (`mediapipe-*-py3-none-win_amd64.whl`).
option_3_mediapipe_pose.inference_profile: Ultra-fast CPU inference (~15-30 ms/frame), self-contained, no PyTorch dependency.
option_3_mediapipe_pose.output_capabilities: 33 2D/3D landmarks with visibility scores, directly supporting the subsequent 3D lifting project phase.

option_4_preconverted_onnx.candidate: ONNX Runtime CPU + Pre-converted MoveNet / YOLO-Pose ONNX
option_4_preconverted_onnx.current_status_in_env: onnxruntime 1.29.0 is already installed and verified operational with CPUExecutionProvider.
option_4_preconverted_onnx.model_availability: Neither Google nor Ultralytics distributes pre-compiled standalone .onnx files via their official release channels (both require local export via tf2onnx/PyTorch).
option_4_preconverted_onnx.limitation: Requires exporting the model on an external unrestricted machine and copying the resulting .onnx into models/.

recommendation.justification: 1) Official Google-distributed win_amd64 binary on PyPI with exact Python 3.11 support. 2) Small download footprint (~22.8 MB vs TensorFlow's ~380 MB). 3) Operates purely on CPU without triggering Windows DLL execution blocks. 4) Provides 33 full-body landmarks (shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles) including visibility flags directly suited for cricket stroke phase analysis.
recommendation.alternative_zero_install: If zero package installations are permitted, Option 4 (supplying a verified ONNX file to onnxruntime 1.29.0) is the only zero-dependency path.
